name: MonarchUploadQueue
title: UploadQueue
wrapsNative: VStack of rows with ProgressView (.monarchLinear), MonarchFileTypeIcon, MonarchButton and Button
summary: The files being uploaded: progress and status per file, cancel, retry and remove, and a summary with the total progress.
whenToUse: When several files upload at once, for example after picking photos or dropping files, so people can follow, cancel and retry them.
whenNotToUse: For one or two files in a composer, use MonarchAttachmentChip.
api: init(_ items: [MonarchUploadQueueItem], showsSummary: Bool = true, usesBinaryUnits: Bool = false, labels: MonarchUploadQueueLabels = MonarchUploadQueueLabels(), onCancel: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onRemove: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onClearFinished: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)

MonarchUploadQueueItem.init(id: String, name: String, size: Int64? = nil, contentType: String? = nil, status: MonarchUploadStatus, progress: Double? = nil, errorMessage: String? = nil, isRetryable: Bool = true, detail: String? = nil)
MonarchUploadQueueCounts.init(_ items: [MonarchUploadQueueItem]); let total, queued, uploading, done, failed, cancelled: Int; var active: Int; var finished: Int
enum MonarchUploadStatus { case queued, uploading, done, failed, cancelled; var isActive: Bool }

struct MonarchUploadQueueLabels { var title, queued, done, failed, cancelled, retry, clearFinished, totalLabel: String?; var uploading: (@Sendable (String?) -> String)?; var retryLabel, cancel, remove, progressLabel, announceDone: (@Sendable (String) -> String)?; var summary, announceFinished: (@Sendable (MonarchUploadQueueCounts) -> String)?; var announceFailed: (@Sendable (String, String?) -> String)? }

options.name: items
options.description: The uploads, in display order. The app updates status and progress.

options.name: showsSummary
options.description: Shows the title, the summary ("2 of 5 uploaded · 1 failed"), the clear button and the total progress.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string and announcement.

options.name: onCancel
options.description: Cancels a queued or uploading file by id. Adds cancel buttons.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries a failed or cancelled, retryable file by id. Adds retry buttons.

options.name: onRemove
options.description: Removes a file that ended from the list by id. Adds remove buttons.

options.name: onClearFinished
options.description: Removes every file that ended. Adds a header button while there is one.

options.name: MonarchUploadQueueItem.progress
options.description: 0 through 1 while uploading; nil shows a moving bar.

options.name: MonarchUploadQueueItem.detail
options.description: Replaces the status line, for example "Checking for viruses".

options.name: usesBinaryUnits
options.description: Writes sizes in 1024-based units, as the web, instead of 1000-based ones.

states.name: uploading
states.description: "Uploading… 40%", a progress bar and a cancel button.

states.name: done
states.description: A check mark and "Uploaded" in the success colour, and a remove button.

states.name: failed
states.description: An error mark and the error in the danger colour, retry and remove buttons.

appearance: A subheading title with a muted caption summary and a linear Monarch progress bar while files are active. Rows are separated by MonarchDivider; each has the file type icon, the name and size, and a caption status line whose colour and icon follow the status.
platformNotes: The web shows an image thumbnail when one is given; here each row shows MonarchFileTypeIcon. The web moves keyboard focus to the next row when a row is removed; iOS does not move VoiceOver focus. Transfers that must survive the app going to the background belong to a background URLSession in the app; the queue only shows them. Progress is a fraction from 0 to 1. Android shares the name and the statuses.
accessibility: The title has the header trait.
Each row is the file name read with its size and status as the value.
Progress bars are standard ProgressViews named "Upload progress of" and the file name; the total bar reads its percentage.
Cancel, retry and remove are separate buttons named with the file name, with 44-point touch targets.
Finished and failed files are announced ("a.pdf uploaded."), and when the last active upload of several ends, the result is announced.
Status is written in words with an icon, so colour is never the only signal.
edgeCases: Total progress leaves out failed and cancelled files, and is weighted by size only when every remaining file has a size.
Retry is not offered for items with isRetryable false.
Long names wrap to two lines and are then shortened in the middle.
The summary's English plural is fixed ("1 of 4 uploaded"); pass labels.summary for other languages.

examples.title: Mixed statuses
examples.setupTemplate:
@State private var items = [
    MonarchUploadQueueItem(id: {{items.0.id}}, name: {{items.0.name}}, size: {{items.0.size}}, status: {{items.0.status|case}}),
    MonarchUploadQueueItem(id: {{items.1.id}}, name: {{items.1.name}}, size: {{items.1.size}}, status: {{items.1.status|case}}, progress: {{items.1.progress|double}} / 100),
    MonarchUploadQueueItem(id: {{items.2.id}}, name: {{items.2.name}}, size: {{items.2.size}}, status: {{items.2.status|case}}),
    MonarchUploadQueueItem(id: {{items.3.id}}, name: {{items.3.name}}, size: {{items.3.size}}, status: {{items.3.status|case}}, errorMessage: {{items.3.error}}),
    MonarchUploadQueueItem(id: {{items.4.id}}, name: {{items.4.name}}, size: {{items.4.size}}, status: {{items.4.status|case}}, errorMessage: {{items.4.error}}, isRetryable: {{items.4.retryable}}),
]
